title: Music You Cannot Choose
sentences: For most of history, hearing music meant being where it was performed.
You listened to whatever the room happened to be playing.
Recording changed that, and the last twenty years changed it completely.
I can now hear almost any piece ever recorded within a few seconds.
Curiously, my listening has narrowed rather than widened.
The system suggests what resembles what I already liked.
The result is comfortable and slightly airless.
I still discover things, but the discoveries feel pre-approved.
The last piece that genuinely surprised me was played by a stranger in a station.
I would never have selected it, which is precisely the point.
